algorithm: Fold every non-alphanumeric byte of cwd to '-' (leading '/' included); reject null bytes and empty paths; truncate to 200 characters. Authoritative implementation: src/poller.rs::cwd_to_slug.
evidence: docs/plan/plan.md (Glossary: JSONL transcript; section 8: Transcript Reader)
